review:
5 Lions Megaways is the Megaways version of Pragmatic's Asian-themed lion slot. The number of symbols on each reel changes every spin, which changes how many ways there are to win.

The bonus is the main event. Three or more bonus symbols anywhere trigger it, and you then pick one of seven free-spins options, trading the number of spins against the size of the wild multipliers: up to 25 free spins, or wilds worth up to 40x. Published RTP is 96.50%. That choice suits players who like deciding between a steadier bonus and a riskier one.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
